tasks.label: Validate frontend_user build via relative prefix
Check frontend_admin process locks
args: $hits = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -like '*frontend_admin*' -or $_.ExecutablePath -like '*frontend_admin*' }; if ($hits) { $hits | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-List } else { Write-Output 'NO_FRONTEND_ADMIN_PROCESS_REFERENCES' }

tasks.label: Check frontend_admin app processes
args: $hits = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -notin @('cmd.exe','powershell.exe') -and (($_.CommandLine -like '*frontend_admin*') -or ($_.ExecutablePath -like '*frontend_admin*')) }; if ($hits) { $hits | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine | Format-List } else { Write-Output 'NO_NON_SHELL_FRONTEND_ADMIN_PROCESS_REFERENCES' }
